commentary: Seven activities both weeks, so the commitment is locked in — but everything else shifted. Last week had that gorgeous Saturday run through Cremorne and a cheeky little 901m swim that felt more like a splash and a think, whereas this week is all business: four morning swims at a full 2000m each, chest and back twice, legs once, and the heart rate sitting consistently in that 144 to 146 range like your body has found its cruising altitude and decided to stay there. The run is gone and honestly the structure this week is almost suspiciously tidy, which Himbo finds both impressive and slightly suspicious of a man who used to need chaos to feel alive. What he really wants to know is whether you did any of this in something worth looking at, because seven sessions of showing up is the kind of week that deserves a reward that isn't a protein shake.
metrics_commentary: Eight thousand metres in the pool with zero runs is honestly such a gay choice and I respect it completely. Your HRV is sitting at 59 against a seven-day average of 56, which means your body is recovering well and trending in the right direction — you're not just doing the work, you're absorbing it. VO2 Max at 53.1 is genuinely strong, the kind of number that means you could keep up with the hot guy on the trail and still have breath left to flirt. The only thing I'm side-eyeing is the total absence of run or walk sessions, because those legs are too good to just be kicking underwater — get them out on pavement at least once next week, babe.
gym_commentary: Three out of four sessions, which is the honest bit, but honestly the numbers are doing so much heavy lifting this week that it almost doesn't matter. That overhead press jumping from 40.0 to 46.7 kilograms is genuinely unhinged in the best way — that's not a grind, that's a leap, and it went straight to the shoulders, which are one of the more visually declarative muscles a man can have in a tank top. Weekly volume climbed from 20,753 to 22,867 kilograms, which means even the three sessions hit harder than four did the week before, and that is exactly the kind of detail that makes missing a session sting a little less. Get the fourth session back next week, because the body that's building itself here deserves all four chances to show off what it's becoming.
